outline.text: Driver's License Physical Exam DOT proves that you are fit to drive a Commercial Vehicle. Meet your employer's requirements and get valuable information about your health. Get A Department of Transportation (DOT) Physical Examination!

The FMCSA physical examination is needed to help guarantee that a person is medically certificated to surely handle a CMV. In the interest of public security, CMV drivers are held to higher mental and emotional, physical, standards than passenger car drivers.

The goal of a DOT physical is to define a likely or current employee's physical fitness, ability to safely handle a commercial vehicle, and capacity to stand up to and endure the physical demands of the job.

A Department of Transportation (DOT) physical is a physical exam that is needed for people who drive commercial vehicles. The objective of a Physical Exam DOT is to determine that people who are driving commercial motor vehicles are emotionally, mentally and physically fit.
Who Needs A Dot Physical Exam in Tampa Florida?
You will need a Physical Exam DOT if you:
Drive a vehicle developed to carry more than 15 people.
Are paid to drive a vehicle developed to carry more than 8 people.
Carry dangerous material in your motor vehicle that needs your vehicle to have a sign.
Driving a combination of vehicles on the interstate with a gross weight rating, gross vehicle weight rating, or combined gross weight of more than 10,000 pounds.
Benefits Of Our Physical Exam Dot
Since you will be undergoing many tests during a DOT Physical, there is a strong chance of detecting underlying diseases. If it is detected early, there is a greater chance of treating it.

If you want to pass the DOT physical, you must be healthy in general. This forces you to eat a well-balanced diet, get enough sleep, minimize alcohol and tobacco, and aim for a better, healthier lifestyle.
What To Expect In Your Driver's License Dot Physical Examination?

If this is your first time seeking employment in the public transportation industry, you may be wondering why you’re required to go for a DOT Physical. Here are the things that you can expect when going for your DOT exam:
What To Expect In Your Driver's License Dot Physical Examination?

There are a lot of suitable restaurants and snacks up and down the road, but they often have big salt levels. Sodium increases your blood pressure (BP), which can cause you to fail the exam.

Sugar and caffeine help stay alert and resilient . Nevertheless, they can also raise blood pressure levels. Make sure to keep away from energy drinks and coffee for at least 24 hours before the DOT physical.
Be sure to sleep well and have a healthy and small breakfast. Avoid heavier meals since they can increase sugar levels and get misinterpreted as a diabetes warning sign on the exam.
What To Expect In Your Driver's License Dot Physical Examination?
Before the tests, you'll be asked to fill out the first part of the Medical Examination Report Form.
All drivers are required to have at least 70" peripheral vision with 20/40 acuity in each eye. If necessary, you may wear corrective lenses or glasses.
Drivers must be able to hear a "forced whisper" at a distance of 5 feet or less, in both ears. You can use headphones if necessary.
The medical examiner will monitor your blood pressure for conditions such as hypertension. They will also check your heart rate for irregularities.
Urinalysis for DOT Physical is not for drug testing. It is done to check your level of sugar and protein to determine if you are diabetic. It is also used to check for any problems with the kidneys.

Your medical examiner will ask you many questions. They will also cover many different categories for the physical exam, including checking your eyes, ears, mouth, heart, spine, and more for any medical conditions.
What If You Don't Have An Updated Dot Physical Certificate?
You will not be authorized to drive a commercial vehicle.

If your certificate expires and goes through a weigh station, it will be considered out of service and you will not be able to complete your delivery. This results in fines and suspensions not only for you but also for your employer.
If you are involved in an accident without a physical certificate from the DOT, you may end up losing your license for life.
